name: review-loop-smoke — one refine iteration then approve (2 iterations, resolved approved)

parsed.feedback: is_prime(4) returns true; use trial division up to floor(sqrt(n))

implement#iter-1.content: fn is_prime(n: u64) -> bool { if n < 2 { return false } let mut i = 2u64; while i * i <= n { if n % i == 0 { return false } i += 1 } true }
